thread:
alex_k: Noticing a sharp p95 jump and ~12-18% 5xx on POST /v1/generate since ~09:10 PT. Some clients timing out. Can someone open a quick bridge? :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Alert: spike detected service=frontend route=/v1/generate p95=1.9s 5xx_rate=0.18
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: models/model-text v2.3 canary @ 2026-02-12T09:05:00Z region=us-west-2
lina_admin: Opening Meet in 60s: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij — join if you can. Quick agenda: 1) root cause triage, 2) check canary vs stable routing, 3) short mitigation, 4) owners for follow-up
jonathan: Oncall here. I'll verify gateway logs and routing table, then check any recent mesh or envoy config changes. pinging infra oncall.
maya: I'll look at model pool nodes (GPU memory, OOMs) and autoscaler events. Running `kubectl -n inference get events --since=15m` now.
alex_k: sample gateway error:
```
ERROR 2026-02-12T16:11:02Z proxy.go:148 request=req-42 upstream=grpc://10.3.2.14:8080 err="rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = KV cache allocation failed"
```
jonathan: ResourceExhausted from KV cache allocation — that suggests runtime cache pressuring out allocations after a traffic burst. I'll pull runtime metrics and heap for model-server instances.
maya: Found several pods with OOMKilled in last 12m: model-server-5fc9, model-server-7f8c. GPU mem usage ~97% on node gpu-node-3. Autoscaler triggered but new node join delayed ~4m.
lina_admin: Proposed immediate actions: A) route /v1/generate to stable model-set in us-west-2, B) flush KV prefix cache on canary pods, C) scale model-pool + increase buffer, D) create postmortem ticket. Who can run the route flip?
jonathan: I can. Running: `rdwctl route set /v1/generate model-set=stable --region=us-west-2` — applying now.
jonathan: Route flip complete. Monitoring metrics — error-rate dropped to ~3% within 90s, p95 down to ~420ms. Still observing a few residual 5xxs.
maya: Manually bumped node count + forced pod reschedule on that pool. Also collecting heap dumps from the OOM pods and uploading to gs://redwood-debug/oom/2026-02-12/ for analysis.
alex_k: Thanks. Can someone add an alert for KV allocation failures specifically? We only had generic 5xx alerts. That would have triggered earlier.
lina_admin: Assigning follow-ups: jonathan -> PR: safer default KV allocation limits + metrics; maya -> autoscaler policy tweak + playbook entry for faster scale-up; alex_k -> open incident ticket and collect client impact summary. I'll own the postmortem and run a 10am PT follow-up tomorrow.
jonathan: PR draft started, will tag infra and runtime reviewers.
maya: heap dumps uploaded and noted in the ticket. Will look for patterns (leaks vs transient pressure).
alex_k: Appreciate the quick responses. Leaving the Meet open for 10 more minutes in case anything else comes up. If not, we'll continue async in the incident thread. :thumbsup:
